info.title: atelie API
info.description:
Authenticate via `POST /api/v1/login` (or `register`), copy the `token` from the response,
then click **Authorize** and paste it to call protected endpoints. Browser clients can rely on
the httpOnly `access_token` cookie instead of the header. All errors follow RFC 7807
(`application/problem+json`); successful responses use a `{ data, message }` envelope.

get.description:
Readiness probe that verifies connectivity to the database, Redis and object storage.
Returns `200` when every dependency is reachable and `503` when any of them is degraded.
Failure reasons are written to the application log, never exposed in the response.

post.description:
Authenticates with email and password. When two-factor authentication is enabled for the
account, a valid TOTP or recovery `code` must also be supplied.

get.description: Returns the profile of the user owning the current token.

delete.description:
Irreversibly erases the authenticated account after confirming the current `password`:
personal data is anonymised, the avatar is removed from storage, every token is revoked
and the auth cookies are cleared. Fulfils the LGPD/GDPR right to erasure.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Your current password, required to confirm the irreversible account deletion.

put.description:
Updates the authenticated user's password after verifying the current one. Every other token
is revoked; the token used for this request stays valid.

post.description: Revokes the token used for the current request and clears the auth cookies.

get.description:
Returns the personal data held about the authenticated account (profile, audit trail
and any administrative access to the account) as a downloadable JSON document,
supporting LGPD/GDPR data-portability and transparency requests.

post.description:
Emails a reset link if the address belongs to an account. Always responds with `204` so the
endpoint cannot be used to discover which emails are registered.

Sets a new password using the token from the reset email. On success every existing token
for the account is revoked.

delete.description:
Ends the active impersonation session, revokes its token and clears the impersonation
cookie, returning the master to their own account.

post.description:
Lets a master temporarily act as another (non-master) user for support, carried by a
time-boxed httpOnly cookie. A reason is required and the access is recorded for audit.

One-time creation of the initial master account with a password. Rejected once any
account exists.

get.description:
Returns a paginated collection of users. Restricted to administrators. Supports
filtering by name or email, sorting, and either length-aware (default) or cursor
pagination.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Filters users whose name or email contains the term.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Column to sort by: name, email or created_at.

post.description:
Creates a staff-managed account without a password and emails a set-password link.
Restricted to staff; only a master may assign an elevated role.

get.description: Returns a single user. Accessible to the user themselves or to administrators.

patch.description: Updates the user's name and/or email. Accessible to the user themselves or to administrators.

delete.description:
Soft-deletes the user (recoverable). Restricted to masters and cannot target the acting
account. Use this for operational removal; the account stays restorable.

post.description:
Irreversibly erases the user's personal data (anonymises identifying fields, removes the
avatar and revokes tokens) and soft-deletes the account. Restricted to masters and cannot
target the acting account. Use this to fulfil a data subject's LGPD/GDPR erasure request.
Restores a soft-deleted user. Restricted to administrators.

Accepts a `jpeg`, `png` or `webp` image up to 2 MB. The image is scaled to fit 512x512,
re-encoded to WebP and stored on public object storage. Accessible to the user or an admin.

delete.description: Deletes the stored avatar. Accessible to the user themselves or to administrators.

post.description:
Emails a link when the address belongs to an account that has not set a password yet.
Always responds `204` so the endpoint cannot reveal which emails are registered.
Confirms a token is still valid before the frontend shows the password form.
Sets the account's first password using the token from the email.

Provisions a TOTP secret and one-time recovery codes, returning the secret, an `otpauth://`
QR URL and the recovery codes. Two-factor is not active until confirmed.
Activates two-factor by verifying a current TOTP `code` against the provisioned secret.

code.description: A 6-digit TOTP code from the authenticator app.

post.description:
Issues a fresh set of one-time recovery codes for an account with two-factor enabled,
invalidating the previous ones. Requires the current `password` (step-up auth).

delete.description:
Removes the TOTP secret and recovery codes from the account. Requires the current
`password` (step-up auth) so a hijacked session cannot strip the second factor.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Your current password, required to confirm this sensitive action.

get.description:
Confirms ownership of the email using the signed link sent on registration. The `id` and
`hash` come from that link and the URL signature must be valid.

post.description: Queues a new verification email for the authenticated user.

The price and production cost are computed from the piece kind, clay, glaze, firing
cycles and settings, then snapshotted; they are never taken from the request body.
Student pieces are charged materials + firing only (no base cost or margin).

pricing are snapshotted at creation and never recomputed.

put.description:
Manual settlement override. Charges normally settle together with the student's
tuition; use this for students with no tuition to bundle against (e.g. tuition-exempt)
or to correct a payment. Restricted to staff.

get.description:
Returns a month's revenue (paid tuition, annual fees, piece charges and commission sales),
expenses (bills + material purchases), net, realized commission margin, per-category piece
margins and activity counts. Defaults to the current month. Restricted to staff.

parameters.name: year

parameters.name: month

get.description:
Returns a consolidated, read-only financial statement for the student: outstanding
balance aged into overdue and upcoming, itemised charges, and recent payment history.
All monetary values are in cents. Accessible to staff or the student themselves.
